slides.body: Two people share a Sun sign and both have a strong 10th house (the house of career). These are illustrative people, not real ones.
The Dasamsa (D-10) is a divisional chart, a magnified view of career. It is read together with the main birth chart.
The D-10 shows a well placed 10th lord, and the running dasha supports career themes. The pattern can support steady progress.
The D-10 shows a stressed 10th lord, and the running dasha is of a planet tied to the 12th house (withdrawal, change). The pattern suggests a slower, more uneven path and a need to build skills.
A Sun-sign horoscope reads neither chart nor dasha. It gives both people the same line.
